jobs.description: As a university of applied sciences, we are particularly committed tosustainable development. Based on our sustainability strategy, we integratesustainability into all degree programs, applied research, and our dailyoperations. With our campuses in Bochum and Heiligenhaus, we provide importantimpulses for the regional development of society and the economy. Numerouscollaborations underline our international focus. We aim to enhance the qualityof our teaching and research by appointing further dedicated and innovativeresearchers.In the Physiotherapy Division of the Department of Nursing, Midwifery andTherapy Sciences at Hochschule Bochum (Bochum University of Applied Sciences),a four-year position is available at the earliest possible date, and no laterthan March 2027, asRESEARCH ASSOCIATE / DOCTORAL STUDENT (f/m/d) for the research Project"multidimensional analytical approaches to improve LBP diagnosis and prognosis"as part of the DFG Research Unit "DYN3M" (EG 13 TV-L)The Project is funded by the German Research Foundation (DFG). The positionis fixed-term for a period of 4 years for academic qualification, with a focuson multimodal data analysis in low back pain. Remuneration is paid in grade E13TV-L, subject to the fulfillment of personal requirements. The working hourscomprise 23 hours and 54 minutes per week (60% of a full-time position). Aspart of this project, a cooperative doctorate at the Doctoral School NRW (PKNRW) is envisaged.The DFG-funded research project "DYN3M" (2026–2030) investigates the dynamicmechanisms of musculoskeletal health and the chronification of low back pain inorder to drive the transition from generic treatment approaches to precise,personalized pain therapy. As part of your doctorate, you will work at theintersection of neuroscience, biomechanics, and data science to examine theinterplay between the musculoskeletal system, neural movement control, andpsychological factors. In doing so, you will apply machine learning andartificial intelligence methods to analyze multimodal data, identifyhigh-dimensional signatures, and develop predictive models to evaluate whetherindividual healing trajectories exist and examing whether specific subgroupsexist for targeted treatments to optimize overall therapeutic success.Responsibilities:- Project coordination and operational implementation of the project.- In addition to project coordination with national and internationalpartners, the project includes conducting subprojects as part of your doctorate.- Learning and implementing quantitative data collection and analysismethods, including machine learning, as well as coordinating and draftingpeer-reviewed publications.- Participating in the development and application of state-of-the-art datascience models in close collaboration with consortium partners frombiomechanics, medicine, and psychology/psychosomatics.- Presenting research findings at national and international conferences andsymposia.- Implementing modern data management standards and, where possible, openscience publication of research outputs (metadata, analytical workflows, code,documentation, etc.) in compliance with the FAIR principles (Findable,Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable).- Interdisciplinary collaboration within the research team.Profile / Requirements:- A completed university degree (Master's degree or an internationallyequivalent degree) in physiotherapy, sports science, data science, statistics,medicine, health sciences, rehabilitation sciences, or a related field, as wellas relevant research experience.- Fulfilment of the formal criteria for enrolment as a doctoral candidate inthe "Social Work and Health" department of the Doctoral College NRW (PK NRW)(see admission requirements of the Department of Social Work and Health at PKNRW)https://www.pknrw.de/abteilungen/soziales-und-gesundheit/gestaltung-des-sozialen-und-gesundheitlichen-wandels- Very good written and spoken English skills (scientific communication) arerequired for the position; fluent German skills are not required.- Experience collaborating in interdisciplinary teams.- Proven experience in statistical analysis.- Experience in machine learning and artificial intelligence is advantageous.- Experience in project coordination, programming (e.g., R, Python), as wellas in preparing scientific publications and grant applications is desirable.What We Offer:You will work in an interdisciplinary team dedicated to musculoskeletal healthhttps://www.hochschule-bochum.de/forschung/ag-muskuskelletare-gesundheit/. Youwill receive comprehensive onboarding, benefit from flexible working hours, andhave access to a modern environment to implement your ideas and projects. jobs.occupation: Backend Engineer - AI Agents (all genders) (Backend-Entwickler/in)
jobs.description: What You'll Be Working OnAt Lime Connect, AI agents already handle customer service conversations for our clients. Now we want to make them better: measurably, and regardless of which language model is currently ahead. That's why we're looking for someone with a backend background who feels at home in the AI world:• You build and improve our AI agents, from the agent loop and tool calling to context management.• You set up our architecture so we can switch language models without rebuilding everything.• Before anything goes live, you use evals to check whether it's actually better. For example, with LLM-as-a-judge and test cases from real customer conversations.• You turn feedback from the service teams working with our agents into concrete improvements. That way, the system keeps getting better step by step.• You connect APIs, MCP tools and website crawling, so our agents have the right knowledge and the right tools.• Within the backend team, you're the go-to person for AI and work closely with Product.What Makes You a Fit• Around five years of backend development, including at least a year building language-model features that real users rely on.• You've built AI agents before and know what context windows, tool calling and prompting mean in practice.• You've worked hands-on with RAG and vector databases.• You have experience with evals, for example with Langfuse, Arize Phoenix or LangSmith, or you've built something similar yourself.• Ideally, you know Pydantic AI, LiteLLM or similar libraries.• You follow what's happening in AI, try new things quickly and take ownership of your topics.• You speak German and English fluently.What’s in It for YouHEALTH & SPORTS• 600 € health budget per year, including 24/7 medical advice — also for family members in your household• Subsidised Urban Sports Club membership (20 € monthly contribution)DEVELOPMENT & GROWTH• Learning budget for courses, books and conferences• Free access to Udemy, Masterclass and language learning apps• Leadership programmes such as "Next Gen" and "Effective Manager"TEAM & CULTURE• Weekly FIKA, movie nights, book club and regular get-togethers and team events• International summer party together with our colleagues in the NordicsWORK ENVIRONMENT• Office-first setup: 3 days in our Cologne office at the MediaPark, 2 days remote• 360° view across Cologne from the 14th floor• Workation within the EU• Snacks, cereal bar and drinks in the officeCOMPENSATION & BENEFITS• Company pension scheme via Zurich with a 30 % employer contribution• Job ticket or mobility budget, plus free parking at the MediaPark• Corporate benefits• 28 days of holiday, plus Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve off• Up to 5 days of special leave for important life eventsAbout usAutomated where it makes sense. Personal where it counts.We are Lime Connect – an AI-first company and one of the top software scale-ups in Cologne. AI isn't an add-on for us, it's the core of what we build: our leading customer messaging solution for customer service, sales, and marketing combines AI agents, web chat, and mobile messaging, already automating the majority of all customer inquiries today. As part of Lime Technologies, our Swedish parent company, we combine international perspectives with the drive of a company actively shaping its next stage of growth. With us, you help shape things, not just execute them – with real ownership from day one, in a dynamic environment, and a culture that values results just as much as people. Weekly fika included.

jobs.occupation: IMPACT PORTFOLIO MANAGER (Fairer Futures Programmes) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: Overview:Fairtrade is the most recognized and trusted sustainability label, working to make trade fairer for people and planet.For more than three decades, Fairtrade has been making an impact on the way trade works. We believe that every farmer and worker should have access to a better way of doing business, and a better way of living. Fairtrade International is an independent non-profit organisation representing more than two million small-scale farmers and workers worldwide. It owns the FAIRTRADE Mark, a registered trademark that appears on more than 37,000 products. Beyond certification, Fairtrade International and its member organisations (three producer networks and 19 national Fairtrade organisations) partner with producers and businesses, engage consumers, and advocate for a fair and sustainable future.Unit’s description and purpose: The Global Impact unit strengthens the Fairtrade system by driving institutional learning and effectiveness through robust monitoring and evaluation systems. We are the hub for the analysis and communication of high-quality data and information about Fairtrade and its impact, as well as supporting strategy delivery. The unit includes the Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) team, which is the Fairtrade system’s hub for MEL which directly connects evidence to strategic decision for the Global Strategy, individual Fairtrade projects and global programmes, Standards, producer support, and more.PRINCIPAL ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:Role purpose: The Impact Portfolio Manager (Fairer Futures Programmes) is responsible for stewarding the MEL frameworks for several of Fairtrade’s global product programmes, the flagship programmatic vehicles through which Fairtrade delivers measurable impact for farmers and workers under its 2026–2028 Global Strategy. The manager will share responsibilities for a total of three programmes (cocoa, banana, coffee) with another manager, with product- and thematic-specific focus to be determined upon hire.Working in close collaboration with Fairtrade Producer Networks, Global Product Teams, and the Digital Service Unit, the role ensures that both programmes are underpinned by robust, coherent, and actionable MEL, from framework design through data collection, reporting, evaluation, and learning. The position serves as one of Fairtrade International's primary MEL contact across programme discussions, representing the Global Impact unit in a system that spans FI, National Fairtrade Organizations, and Producer Networks. This role also contributes to the Global Impact unit's impact services offer, drawing on programme MEL expertise to identify and develop customized services for the Fairtrade system and external partners.Main Responsibilities:            - MEL Framework, Indicators, and Data Management. Steward and drive the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Theory of Change and MEL framework for several of the Fairer Futures Programmes, working in close collaboration with Producer Networks and Global Product Teams. Steward the KPI and activity/output indicator set for both programmes, including maintaining metadata and monitoring data quality. Work with PN MEL staff, Global Product Teams, and where needed external consultants to ensure systematic consolidation of existing programme data and the design and implementation of regular data collection processes. Coordinate with the Information & Knowledge team on data cleaning, analysis, and visualisation.- Stakeholder Engagement and Project MEL Alignment. Serve as Fairtrade International's primary MEL contact for the product-expert colleagues in Producer Networks and Global Product Teams, providing technical MEL guidance, supporting capacity on data collection and reporting, and ensuring programme MEL requirements are understood and operationalised across the system. Work with PNs to ensure that MEL frameworks for individual projects within both programme portfolios are aligned to the overarching programme frameworks, providing where capacity is available guidance and quality assurance at project inception and during implementation- Reporting, Synthesis, and Learning. Lead the preparation of programme-level MEL reporting for programmes, synthesising data and evidence from across the programme portfolio into outputs that feed into the overall strategy reporting cycle. Facilitate learning processes within programmes, identifying evidence-based insights and working with Global Product Teams and PNs to support programme adaptation where warranted. Ensure programme MEL evidence and KPI data are appropriately integrated into the overall strategy MEL cycle in close coordination with the designated strategy MEL lead within the Impact Management team.- Programme Evaluation. Lead the design, commissioning, and management of the programme evaluations. This includes developing evaluation questions in collaboration with PNs and Global Product Teams, overseeing evaluation partners, and ensuring findings are translated into actionable learning.- Impact Services and External Engagement. Identify opportunities to offer MEL technical services to Fairtrade system organisations and external partners, drawing on expertise developed through the programmes. Contribute to the scoping, design, and pitching of impact services in collaboration with the Head, with a particular focus on programme MEL, data collection design, and evaluation. Participate actively in relevant system-wide working groups, representing the Impact Management team's MEL perspective on cross-organisational initiatives.Other tasks that are consistent with the level and responsibilities of this post.SKILLS REQUIRED:Level of education: The position holder will have a Master’s degree or higher in development economics, econometrics, applied sociology, social sciences or another relevant field in management or natural sciences. Years of professional experience: A minimum of five years' experience in monitoring, evaluation, and learning, with demonstrable experience designing and managing MEL frameworks for multi-stakeholder projects or programmes. At least two years' experience working in or with stakeholders from the Global South, preferably in agricultural or commodity supply chain contexts. Experience in coffee and bananas is an advantage.Language requirements: Fluency in English required. Professional proficiency in Spanish is a advantage. Job Specific Competencies/knowledge: - Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning- Project and Programme Management- International Development Expertise- Stakeholder Management- Planning and execution- Data Collection Design and Management- Evaluation Design and Commissioning- Enhancing data-driven decision making- Data Analysis (quantitative and qualitative)- Data Reporting and Synthesis- Capacity BuildingPersonal Qualities: - Cross-cultural communication- Facilitation- Rapid Learning- Collaboration/Teamwork- Customer Service- Presentation Skills- Relationship Management- Evidence Collecting- Flexibility- Feedback sourcingSoftware/Tools: - Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Outlook, Powerpoint, Teams, Planner)- Kobo Toolbox (or similar survey design and implementation tools)- Miro (or similar online whiteboarding tools)- Canva (or similar graphic design tools)- Claude.ai (or similar AI  tools)- Toladata (or similar project monitoring MEL platform)- Power BI (or similar business intelligence software)TERMS AND CONDITIONS:- This is a two-year full-time position within Fairtrade International.- Location is at Fairtrade International offices in Bonn, Germany with the opportunity for hybrid work arrangements- The office language is English.- Salary as per the Collective Bargaining Agreement for the Wholesale and Foreign Trade Industries for North Rhine Westphalia Group 6a and over tariff payments starting from €5455 Gross per month- Holiday Bonus and 13th salary  - 30 days of holidays per year (for fulltime employees)- Subsidised public transportation ticket- Subsidised meal services- Childcare cost subsidy Please note that Fairtrade International is strict on compliance with the required qualification criteria mentioned above, and only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Fairtrade International is an independent non-profit organisation representing more than two million small-scale farmers and workers worldwide. To this end GPPP provides information, tools and strategic direction as the main outputs. GPPP facilitates and contributes to coherent implementation of strategic plans within the Fairtrade system. GPPP develops new ways of delivering Fairtrade’s intended impact in a changing business environment and risk context.PRINCIPAL ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:Role purpose: The Cocoa Manager is responsible for implementation of GPPP cocoa works based on work schedule agreed with the Senior Advisor Cocoa. The work will deliver measurable impact for farmers and workers under its 2026–2028 Global Strategy. The Cocoa Manager joins a team that works fluidly, sharing responsibilities across multiple workstreams supporting each other where the need is the greatest to achieve their objectives. The environment is dynamic and priorities can shift with external events impacting workplans.  In addition to other duties the Cocoa Manager, working within GPPP cocoa, will  work in close collaboration with Producer Networks, National Fairtrade Organisations and the Fairtrade International Global Impact team responsible for Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning, to ensure the Fairer Futures Programme – West Africa Cocoa is implemented professionally and on time. The programme is primarily focused on increasing the household income of farmers who are members of Small Producer Organisaitons in the programme. The programme leads to farm level interventions through Small Producer Organisaitons including pruning, cocoa tree planting and shade tree planting among others. The programme includes further interventions on income such as Village Savings and Loans Association, and interventions on social compliance including increasing the effectiveness of child labour monitoring, reporting and remediation. Future working responsibilities may extend to other geographies and other commodities.Main Responsibilities:            - Supporting National Fairtrade Organisations, in their responsibilities to maintain and grow the market for Fairtrade cocoa.- Supporting Producer Networks, in their work with Small Producer Organisations, and maintaining and growing the market for Fairtrade cocoa.- Programme design. Working with Fairtrade International monitoring, evaluation and learning experts and the Producer Network to ensure implementation and prioritisation of effective monitoring, evaluation and learning in a timely manner.- External programme reporting. Working with Fairtrade International monitoring, evaluation and learning experts, Producer Network and National Fairtrade Organisations ensuring agreed reporting deadlines are met with quality reporting to be used with commercial stakeholders, government and other interested stakeholders.- External stakeholder engagement, traders. Working closely with the Producer Network manage relationships with exporter, importer and processers of cocoa who purchase Fairtrade cocoa from Small Producer Organisaitons. Traders are a critical part of the supply chain and their incorporation into the programme is desired and necessary.- External stakeholder engagement, events. Working with National Fairtrade Organisations you will be speaking at public and trade events on the strategic objectives of our work, the progress and impact with the aim of influencing the sector.- External stakeholder engagement, media. Where required you will interact with media.- Fairtrade Standards and Pricing. Liaising with the lead department in Fairtrade on standards and pricing, Fairtrade’s Standards Unit and Pricing Unit, you will be working on standards and pricing matters relating to Fairtrade’s cocoa work and the programme. This will include and not limited to consultations, queries and evolution of standards and pricing. Other tasks that are consistent with the level and responsibilities of this post.SKILLS REQUIRED:Level of education: The position holder will have an undergraduate degree in science or the arts. Years of professional experience: A minimum of three years' experience in complex project management which includes implementation in the global South and preferably West Africa.Language requirements: Fluency in English and French required. Professional proficiency in Spanish is an advantage. jobs.description: Job available in 4 locations: Dresden, Halle, Leipzig, RemoteWork ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionAs part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.Territory: Eastern & Central GermanyZIP Codes: 01, 02, 04, 06, 07, 08, 09, 30, 31, 32, 34, 36, 37, 38, 99Field-based / Remote within the territoryDiscover Impactful WorkWe are looking for an experienced Account Manager (m/f/d) – Clinical Diagnostics to drive commercial growth across Eastern and Central Germany.In this field-based role, you will take ownership of a strategically important sales territory, developing existing customer relationships while identifying and winning new business opportunities.As a trusted advisor to clinical laboratories and healthcare customers, you will combine your scientific understanding with a consultative sales approach to identify customer needs, understand laboratory workflows and develop solutions that deliver measurable value.You will work closely with customers, key decision-makers and internal cross-functional teams to expand our market presence, increase revenue and strengthen long-term partnerships.A Day in the Life- Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans to achieve or exceed annual sales targets- Take full ownership of revenue growth, decision-makers- Apply a consultative selling approach to understand customer applications, workflows, challenges and future requirements- Position Thermo Fisher Scientific’s clinical diagnostic solutions effectively and develop compelling value propositions- Manage the complete sales cycle, from opportunity identification and customer engagement through negotiation and closing- Collaborate closely with Applications, Technical Service, Marketing, Customer Service and other commercial teams to deliver an outstanding customer experience- Maintain an accurate and high-quality sales pipeline, forecast and customer data within Salesforce- Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer developments to identify new growth opportunities- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at customer meetings, industry events, conferences and exhibitions- Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and develop sustainable, long-term business partnershipsKeys to SuccessYou combine a strong scientific or technical background with commercial drive and a genuine passion for understanding and solving customer challenges.You are comfortable managing a large territory independently, identifying growth opportunities and engaging with stakeholders at different levels of an organization.
